subject: CloudRise x Redwood — co-sell demo coordination & ops runbook
messages:
From: Sarah Mills <sarah.mills@cloudrise.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: CloudRise Ops <ops@cloudrise.com>
Date: Fri, 25 Sep 2026 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Marketplace co-sell opportunity — demo logistics

Hi Hannah,

Great to connect at Summit last week — appreciate the intro. We’re ready to move forward with a joint co-sell demo for our mutual customer (pre-sales call next week) and want to lock a time that works for the Redwood + AWS SI + CloudRise folks.

High-level ask: can Redwood run the product demo (30–35m) and host a 15-minute ops/recording run-through (tech handoff + recording permissions)? We have two constraints: AWS SI can only do mornings PT, and CloudRise wants session recorded and hosted in our S3 (we can share upload details).

Preferred windows (all PT):
- Tue 10/5 9:30–11:00
- Thu 10/7 8:30–10:00

If neither works, we can do a late-afternoon fallback 10/6 16:00–17:30 PT but would prefer morning.

Can you propose one or two confirmed slots and provide a short runbook for the 15-minute ops preflight? Also /please/ confirm recording ownership and whether Redwood needs a signed MOA. I attached CloudRise MOA v2 for your legal team to scan.

Thanks — Sarah

--
Sarah Mills
Partnerships, CloudRise
sarah.mills@cloudrise.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Mills <sarah.mills@cloudrise.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 28 Sep 2026 09:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace co-sell opportunity — demo logistics

Hi Sarah — thanks, this is great context.

We can run the demo and take the ops run-through. From Redwood’s side I propose:
- Demo slot (preferred): Tue 10/5 10:00–11:00 PT (fits AWS SI morning constraint)
- Backup slot: Thu 10/7 09:00–10:00 PT

Ops run-through: 15 minutes immediately before the demo (09:45 PT for the Tue slot). We’ll send a short runbook + checklist; I’ve attached an initial dry-run doc (redwood-runbook-dryrun-v1.docx) with roles and recording steps. Vanessa — can you confirm recorder ownership and whether Redwood can push a copy to CloudRise S3 after processing?

On the MOA: we’ll route to Legal. Karthik — can you confirm any required AWS SI redlines (if they need to be looped in prior to the demo)?

If that slot works for you I’ll calendar invite the full triage group and include the runbook.

Thanks,

Hannah Schmitt
Manager, Solutions Partnerships
Redwood Inference
hannah.schmitt@redwood.com
--
(attachment: redwood-runbook-dryrun-v1.docx)

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Sarah Mills <sarah.mills@cloudrise.com>
Cc: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 29 Sep 2026 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace co-sell opportunity — demo logistics

Hi all — quick ops note from the recording/infra side.

Confirmed: Redwood can record and push a processed MP4 to CloudRise S3; we need a short S3 write role and a target bucket (CloudRise to share IAM/temporary creds or bucket policy). Olga — I’ll need you to own recording failover (local backup to our OPS vault) and the post-call upload step.

A couple of ops bullets for the runbook (Hannah, feel free to add to the attached doc):
- Preflight (15m): mic check, screen-share pass, SI connectivity confirm, recording consent (all attendees), S3 upload test (5MB file)
- Fallback: if S3 upload fails, we hold a second window 30 minutes after demo for manual upload
- Recording owner: Redwood (Olga) will keep master for 7 days; CloudRise gets processed file within 48h

On slots: Tue 10/5 10:00 PT works for me. I’ll block 09:30–11:30 PT as a buffer and own the OPS preflight.

Olga — can you confirm you’ve got capacity to own the recording for that window?

Thanks — Vanessa

--
Vanessa Ortiz
Partner Programs, Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com

From: Sarah Mills <sarah.mills@cloudrise.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: CloudRise Ops <ops@cloudrise.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 01 Oct 2026 09:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace co-sell opportunity — demo logistics

Perfect — Tue 10/5 10:00 PT is confirmed on our end. Thank you for the quick turn.

We’ve shared the S3 bucket details with ops@cloudrise.com; I copied them here so Vanessa/Olga can coordinate IAM. HubSpot deal: https://hubspot.example.com/deal/DR-8342 (I’ve put the confirmed time on the record).

Action items:
- Hannah: send calendar invite to Redwood + CloudRise + AWS SI (we’ll provide SI contact details by EOD Mon)
- Vanessa/Olga: finalize runbook and S3 upload test (we’ll run the 15-minute preflight at 09:45 PT)
- Karthik: prepare a 5-min SI slide to show architecture compatibility and any compliance caveats
- Legal: [CloudRise MOA v2] — we’ll await Redwood Legal redline; no blocker for demo scheduling

Looking forward — Sarah
